contexts.name: interview-execution-scoring

contexts.name: interview-lab-harness

Covers student-mode interview constraints and locale-specific prep string formatting.
contexts.name: interview-planning-rubric

On completion it redirects the candidate to their durable /status link.
contexts.name: interview-portal

contexts.name: jd-builder-templates

Entry for recruiters who prefer dialogue over form-filling.

Central recruiter surface for surveying and acting on the JD inventory.

This is the recruiter's main entry point for the jobs workspace.
